Title: Blood Tears Of Kephran Timing Question

Messages.Author: serge

vampire burn the Blood Tears before being moved to the uncontrolled

vote and decided at that time to burn the Blood Tears, is this legal?
Thanks.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <448a24d3$1...@dnews.tpgi.com.au>, Salem
<salem_ch...@hotmail.com> writes:
<snip - burning Blood Tears during a referendum>

>I assume doing so would trigger a round of 'response' effects from
>other players that wish to do so, also before polling closes? (eg:
>Telepathic Vote Counting)

Voting is free-form, so you don't have the normal sequence of effects
like you would for other events.

However, the rules making it clear that there is always time for more
votes to be cast. It's not like someone starts a clock with 30 seconds
for the referendum, and anyone sneaking something in with half a second
left can do it without responses.

The polling stage is completed only when all Methuselahs are
finished voting (if you need a time limit, the players can agree
to wait 15 seconds after the last vote cast to close the polling
stage).

The rulebook is only talking about "voting" per se, but that pretty much
applies to any effect done during polling. Obviously, if everyone is
done you don't need to wait the 15 seconds - you just need to establish
everyone really is done.
